en: Black‑and‑white vintage view over a wide river with two bridges in the foreground: a lower stone arch bridge carrying light traffic and a higher iron truss railway bridge further back. On the opposite bank is a dense European town with multi‑storey riverside buildings, a curving embankment road, and two tall church spires rising above the houses. Rolling hills with scattered buildings and trees form the background. The photograph has rough, dark margins and some damage at the bottom, giving it the look of an early 20th‑century postcard or photographic print.
